name: Pork or Chicken Schnitzel (Pan-Fried Cutlet)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Magic · Rapunzel's Royal Table / Disney Treasure · Worlds of Marvel
whyItWorks: Pounding pork or chicken breast paper-thin breaks down tough muscle fibers before cooking, making it tender on the stomach when not overly greasy.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order with smooth mashed potatoes or white rice instead of fried potato hash/salad, and skip any lemon wedge or berry compote with seeds.
